params.body:
Clears the signups a script typed into the newsletter form on the night of 10 to 11 November 2026, before Turnstile closed the form (#273, #274), and keeps unconfirmed signups from piling up again.

## What changes

- `gentells:newsletter-prune` removes newsletter rows that were never confirmed and never unsubscribed, created more than `--days` ago (default 7). Without `--apply` it only counts, per day and per form, and prints no addresses.
- The command runs nightly at 02:00 with `--days=7 --apply`. Anyone who has not confirmed within a week is removed; they can subscribe again.
- Not touched: confirmed readers, and unsubscribed rows, which record that someone said no.

An unconfirmed row gets no letter and never went to Clay, so removing it loses nothing but a stranger's address.

## To clear last night's signups (Forge > gentells.com > Commands)

```
php artisan gentells:newsletter-prune --days=0
php artisan gentells:newsletter-prune --days=0 --apply
```

The first command only counts. `--days=0` also takes anyone who subscribed this morning and has not yet clicked their link; they can subscribe again.

## Tests

`NewsletterPruneTest`: without `--apply` nothing is deleted; only old unconfirmed rows go, while recent, confirmed and unsubscribed rows stay; `--days=0` takes every unconfirmed row. The full suite passes apart from BuildStampTest, which fails in any worktree.
